description: This file defines the code-behind for the AdminLeaderboard page in an ASP.NET Web Forms application. It contains event handlers for page load and button clicks, with some database-related code commented out. Its main purpose appears to be managing the leaderboard view and navigation for an admin user.

classes.name: AdminLeaderboard
classes.description: Code-behind class for the AdminLeaderboard ASP.NET page, handling page lifecycle events and button actions.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; currently contains commented code for initial data loading.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the AdminPanel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the AdminQueue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Empty event handler for leaderboard button, potentially for future implementation.

methods.description: Logs out the user and transfers to the LoginPage.
